description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests to set the hardware LAN port enable state, specifically for the Home Security feature. It includes utility files, checks user session login status, validates parameters, fetches current configuration from backend, updates enable/disable states for specific LAN ports, and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values from backend configuration for specified object name, parameter array, and mapping.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a string value for a specified backend path, returns true on success.
